test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2022: Official Paper (Held On: 10 March, 2023 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: If tan A + sec A = K, then what is the value of sin A?
solution:
Given:

tan A + sec A = k

Formula used:

tan A + sec A = a, then tan A - sec A = 1/a

Sec A = H/B

sin A = P/H

Calculation:

sec A + tan A = k, then sec A - tan A = 1/k

Using this sec A = 1/2(k + 1/k) = (k² +1)/2k

Sec A = H/B

H = (k2 +1)

B = 2k

Using Pythagorean theorem

H² = P² + B²

(k2 +1)² = P2 + (2k)2

P = k2 -1

sin A = P/H

sin A = k2 -1/k2 +1

**∴ Option 3 is the correct answer.**
